test_cases.name: Basic True Crime Script
test_cases.input: In 1985, John Doe disappeared from Columbus, Ohio. Police said he was likely abducted. The case went cold for 30 years. In 2015, DNA evidence linked a suspect to the crime. According to investigators, the perpetrator was arrested in Chicago. This groundbreaking discovery solved a decades-old mystery.
expected_outputs: Voice audit: check for tone consistency

test_cases.name: Script with Forbidden Words
test_cases.input: This robust case delves into the landscape of unsolved crimes. The testament to their hard work is important to note. Furthermore, the investigation represents a transformative moment in forensics.
expected_outputs: Forbidden words detected: robust, delves, landscape, testament, important to note, Furthermore, transformative

test_cases.name: Script with Narrative Gaps
test_cases.input: Sarah disappeared. Therefore, police launched an investigation. The case went cold because new leads were exhausted quickly. It's important to note the psychological impact on her family.
expected_outputs: Logical gap: 'Therefore' appears without sufficient prior setup
Forbidden phrase detected: It's important to note
